parent_objective: redesign replay/recovery residual balance after retention-heavy projection

forbidden_shortcuts: do not lower exact or replay thresholds
do not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
do not count replay-anchor collapse as driver progress
hypothesis: A more selective replay/recovery balance can preserve M411 proof gates without collapsing the candidate back to M400 behavior.
success_criteria: define active-set replay residuals that only push rows or branches near replay failure
define recovery-preservation terms that retain M406 movement where replay gates are not threatened
define a measurable Pareto acceptance rule for replay retention versus recovery utility
pre-register the next no-PPO implementation or probe milestone
failure_criteria: design treats scalar replay-anchor collapse as sufficient progress
design weakens exact or replay gates
design cannot be tested without PPO

commands.name: replay_recovery_balance_design
commands.command: Design the next selective replay/recovery residual after M412 retention-heavy audit; no PPO.

decision_rule: M413 should admit implementation only if it creates a testable no-PPO residual balance that preserves proof gates without rewarding replay-anchor collapse.
